Becca Balint - 118th Congress (Cropped).jpg | candidate1 = [[Becca Balint]] | party1 = Democratic Party (United States) | 1data1 = | 2data1 = | image2 = Gerald Malloy for US Senate Vermont (cropped1).jpg | candidate2 = Gerald Malloy | party2 = Republican Party (United States) | 1data2 = | 2data2 = | map_image = | map_size = 325px | map_caption = | title = U.S. representative | before_election = [[Becca Balint]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = | after_party = }} {{ElectionsVT}} The '''2026 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect a member of the [[United States House of Representatives]] to represent [[Vermont]]'s [[Vermont's at-large congressional district|at-large district]]. [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] incumbent [[Becca Balint]] is seeking a third term. She is being challenged by [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] former military officer Gerald Malloy. [[Primary elections]] took place on August 11, 2026.{{Cite web|title=2026 State Primary Election Dates|url=https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2026-state-primary-election-dates|website=[[National Conference of State Legislatures]]|date=May 9, 2025|access-date=August 5, 2025}} In the Democratic primary, Balint secured 98.4% of the vote against [[write-in]] opposition.
